culture.title: Yongfeng chilli sauce
culture.text: In Yongfeng, Shuangfeng County, fermented wheat forms the base of a chilli sauce finished in the sun. The provincial culture department documents the preparation from grain fermentation to mixing chopped peppers and sunning the sauce.

source.title: Hunan Department of Culture and Tourism · Yongfeng chilli sauce

culture.title: Fuhoutang and its libraries
culture.text: Fuhoutang, the Zeng family residence in Heye, lies within Shuangfeng County. The provincial archives describe its surviving private book towers alongside family letters and diaries—a different setting from the county-seat streets.

culture.title: Shigu Academy at the rivers
culture.text: Shigu Academy stands in urban Hengyang near the meeting of the Zheng, Xiang and Lei rivers. The city’s account connects the academy with the long history of teaching and scholarship at Shigu Mountain.

culture.title: Huiyan Peak and the geese
culture.text: Huiyan Peak is an urban Hengyang landmark associated with poems about migrating geese. Its name recalls the local story that southbound geese turn back here; the district’s guide presents the pavilions, temple and literary associations.

culture.title: Dajiangkou dragon boats
culture.text: Dajiangkou town in Xupu County hosts the local Great Dragon Boat Festival. The county’s account of the June 2024 gathering documents both exhibition paddling and races, including four women’s teams in the exhibition event.

source.title: Xupu county government · Dajiangkou festival, June 2024

culture.title: Xiang Jingyu’s former home
culture.text: Xiang Jingyu’s former home is on Jingyu West Road in Xupu’s county seat. The provincial guide describes restored domestic displays alongside manuscripts, including school essays, diaries, reading notes and letters.

source.title: Hunan provincial government · Xiang Jingyu former home

culture.title: Chenhe high-pitched opera
culture.text: Chenxi has a nationally listed Chenhe gaoqiang tradition and a local protection centre. The national heritage register describes this theatre’s mix of high-pitched singing, tanqiang and some kunqiang, with a performance area extending beyond the county.

source.title: China Intangible Cultural Heritage Museum · Chenxi Chenhe gaoqiang

culture.title: Wubaotian’s courtyard houses
culture.text: Wubaotian village lies in Shangpuxi Yao Township within Chenxi County. The provincial heritage bureau documents timber courtyard houses enclosed by high fire walls and gates. This is county cultural geography, not evidence that its residents share the study’s pronunciation.

source.title: Hunan Cultural Heritage Bureau · Wubaotian village
